verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own docs cover all three pillars in one platform: spend (corporate cards with controls, expenses), bill pay (Bills API, accounts payable, transfers to suppliers) and banking (a business account, Global Accounts, multi-currency wallet). That supports consolidating point solutions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that founders actually replace separate tools, and explicit documentation of consolidation or migration from existing point solutions.

support.subject: As a founder, I can replace multiple point solutions for spend, bill pay, and banking with one consolidated platform

citations.quote: Control, automate, and reconcile global company spend across expenses and accounts payable.
The Bills API lets you create and manage invoices received from vendors for goods or services.
Best Corporate Cards: 2% Cashback, Spend Controls & No FX Fees
Open a Business Account In Minutes for Global Businesses
Global Accounts enable you to receive bank transfers into and authorize direct debit payouts from the Wallet.
Airwallex Transfers allows you to move funds across the globe easily to your suppliers, employees, contractors and/or own bank accounts.
